# Chapter 04 · Population Characterization and Optimization {.unnumbered}
*Criterion Functions · Argmin · Estimating Equations · Constraints*

식별된 population target을 criterion minimizer, estimating-equation root, constrained solution으로 표현하는 방법을 다룹니다. existence·uniqueness·convexity·KKT·misspecification·local geometry를 연결합니다.

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
